factorized_runtime_inputs.description: Formal Factorized scheduler inputs. NO V5 utility/regrasp/uncertainty.

fields.candidate_close: Runtime-causal. Source: Codex action contract. NOT teacher event_id.
fields.action_known: Runtime-causal. Whether action intent is reliably classified.
fields.student_valid: Runtime-causal. Source: Codex. NOT route_supported proxy.
fields.route_supported: Whether mechanism route is in supported set.
fields.release_probability: sigmoid(release_logit). Conservative veto candidate. Not pure-release equivalent.

calibration.purpose: fit calibrators, compute head discrimination/calibration metrics
calibration.forbidden: must not affect scheduler state transitions

evaluation.purpose: audit-only — judge whether scheduler emit is correct
evaluation.forbidden: must not affect scheduler state transitions

k10_opportunity.description: strict_k10_feasible[t] already means a complete T10 window exists starting at t.
k10_opportunity.positive_episode: at least one VALID_START in the eligible domain
k10_opportunity.negative_episode: ALL positions in the eligible domain are known AND strict_k10_feasible=false for ALL
k10_opportunity.unknown_episode: eligible domain has any unknown position, AND no known positive exists
k10_opportunity.eligible_domain: steps 0 to T-10 (positions that can host a complete T10 window), per Teacher contract
k10_opportunity.no_double_horizon: Do NOT require consecutive feasible-start blocks of min_length=8. Do NOT require emit_step+9 within a feasible-start block.
k10_opportunity.containment: emit_step is a VALID_START — containment is inherent in the strict_k10_feasible definition
k10_opportunity.insufficient_coverage: If Teacher bundle lacks complete eligible-domain known info, classify as BLOCKED_INSUFFICIENT_K10_KNOWN_COVERAGE

L1A.name: non_close_intent_head_activation_diagnostic
L1A.note: candidate_close=false ≠ physical background. Includes normal release, OPEN actions, non-grasp phases.

L1B.name: teacher_background_head_activation_diagnostic
L1B.note: Offline diagnostic only. Uses Teacher label. Cannot enter runtime scheduler.

calibration.fit_priority: grasp_logit, manipulation_logit, release_logit (raw logits). Probability only for consistency audit.

provenance_classes.INDEPENDENT_CALIBRATION: calibration identities NOT used in checkpoint training
provenance_classes.TRAIN_RESUBSTITUTION_CALIBRATION: calibration identities WERE used in checkpoint training — NON_AUTHORITATIVE

fit_pipeline: verify bundle seal, checkpoint SHA, source commit, feature-order SHA
classify provenance as INDEPENDENT or TRAIN_RESUBSTITUTION
fit per-head calibrator using Teacher known mask (sample selection only)
select threshold on independent calibration/policy-selection data (identity-disjoint from fit and heldout)
calibration.insufficient_samples_policy: method_status = HOLD_INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLES, method_valid = false. Do NOT silently fall back to RAW.
forbidden: per-split best-method selection based on heldout
silent RAW fallback when method fails

formal_gate.authoritative_l3: HOLD — requires Codex V2 handoff + independent calibration artifacts + 12-split runtime bundle
